d: Anant Singh Daughter Wedding :bihar ke bahubli neta anant sinh ki beti shivangi ki shadi ko lekar khas taiyariyan ki gaee hain. shadi samaroh men ghurdaur ka aayojan bhi aakarshan ka kendr bana huaa hai. barish ke bad ghurdaur ke aayojan par sanshay tha, lekin anant sinh ne khud morcha sanbhalte hue maidan ko taiyar karvaya. vahin, shivangi ki shadi men panjab ke ludhiyana se 25 se adhik kinnar patna pahunche hain. kinnar samaj ke logon ne paranprik git gakar var-vadhu ko aashirvad diya. dekhie anant sinh ki beti ki shadi men ghurdaur ki taiyariyon se lekar khas mehmanon ki maujudgi tak ki…
